title: Shiraishi An — Hop In!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You always get so excited during lunch, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, duh!
Unlike classes, lunch doesn't make me sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
An...
If you're not careful, your grades are gonna...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope! Nope! Not listening!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm keeping up with what's going in class just fine right now! I'm not gonna fail any tests this year...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Whatever you say.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, ice cold!
Do you have that little faith in me?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I mean, An, you don't really study at home, right? You always go straight to practice after school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's just...
I need to focus on my singing right now.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
And your weekends are all booked too, right?
Did you go somewhere to perform yesterday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup!
We went to a live house in Shizuoka yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
What?! Shizuoka?!
No fair! That's like a real trip!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, did you bring back any souvenirs for us...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nope!
We didn't have time to buy any.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it's not like we did any sightseeing either. We mostly just looked at whatever we could see out the car.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Wait, that's it?!
You guys went all the way to Shizuoka and didn't do any sightseeing?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope. We came up with a plan for the event on the drive over, performed, helped clean up and did a debrief on the drive back.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You're really investing all your energy into singing, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Also, it's so nice of your dad to drive you guys to all these places! My dad would never do that for me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, my dad's the one who's been calling in favors to get these places to let us perform...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, I totally forgot.... Your dad used to be a pro, right?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I saw him by the school gate the other day. He's so good-looking!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, stop right there!
Now I feel really embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry, my bad!
But he really does seem like a cool dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (As embarrassing as this is, it's not the worst...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I did used to think Dad was the coolest person in the world whenever I saw him performing on stage.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you guys are that interested, wanna see him performing in an event...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There aren't many, but some videos of him singing do exist.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They're pretty old. We're talking about stuff from like twenty years ago. If you guys are interested, I could lend them to you...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I wanna see them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll bring some over sometime.
A week later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you doing getting your classmates to swoon over your dad...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That wasn't my plan!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I couldn't help it. I was just so happy that they were showing so much interest in him that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, how'd they react?
What did they think of RADder?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, about that!
You should've seen them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was worried at first because of how old the video was, but Dad and his team still sounded amazing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, this is RADder we're talking about.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I know.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We need to get to that level too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The same level as RADder. No, more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have to get to the point where we've left them in the dust!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You don't have to tell me that.
After all, our goal's to surpass their most intense moment.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...! So, let's do our best again during practice today!
